text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, July 14 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant. 5 Vessels due by 26/7, no delays.
Hay Point - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 7 due by 28/7. No delays.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 3 waiting, 36 due by 29/8. No delays.
Gladstone - Curragh still on strike (9th week). Mine management and unions expected to return to negotiations this week in a bid to end the dispute.
R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 1 waiting, 22 due by 20/8.
Barney Point - Berth vacant. 5 Vessels due by 20/8. No delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant. 3 Vessels due by 29/7. No delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - The old shiploader at Kooragang is scheduled for repairs estimated to require 3 separate 5 week periods. The initial periods have been deferred due to the backlog of tonnage off the port. Hunter Valley No.1 mine - No immediate prospect of settlement in sight. The CFMEU and the national union body (ACTU) are endeavouring to localise the strike by ensuring coal is prevented from leaving the mine. Rio Tinto/Coal and Allied are pressing the industrial commission to instruct the rail workers union to transport the coal to Newcastle for export. A decision from the commission on this is not expected before 14/7. Coal and Allied confirm that no force majeure declaration has been made and export commitments are being maintained.
Kooragang - Two vessels loading, 22 waiting, 13 due by 27/7. 13-14 Days delay.
Dyke 4+5 - 1 Vessel loading, 20 waiting, 9 due by 23/7. 13 Days delay.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 22 due by 28/8. No delays.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to the occasional shortage of lump and fines and yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some delays to berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. Vessels currently scheduled to berth out of order have been forced to do so due to yandi shortages, i.e. can only load one vessel with yandi cargo at a time. The wharf length 657 metres also restricts loading of large vessels concurrently as access to all hatches is restricted. Berth A - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored. Berth B - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 15 due by 26/7, 3 others due with no eta.
Goldsworthy - (Finucane Island) - 1 Vessel loading, 3 due by 21/7, 3 others due with no eta.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored. Maintenance shutdown for 24 hours. 6 Anchored. E.I. Island - 1 Loading, 5 anchored, 1 due 15/7.
Dampier lineup - 25 Vessels due by 3/8.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 1 berthed, 7 due by 29/7.

July 16 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - One sorghum vessel due 25/7. Grain terminal currently carrying out extensive maintenance of shiploader. Grain berth also being fitted with cargo crane for handling bulk commodities for import and export to increase utility of No.5 wharf. This work should not cause any delays at this stage to the vessel arriving 25/7. Gladstone - One sunflower vessel due 18/7.
Brisbane - No vessels due.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Four vessels due by 27/7.
Sydney - No further grain loading expected at this port.
Port Kembla - Four wheat vessels due by 26/7. Berthing programme based on grade of cargo receivals by rail. Grain terminal closed until 16/7 due to maintenance.
VICTORIA - Geelong - Six vessels due by 15/8.

Portland - Two barley vessels due by 2/8. From 11/8 to 25/8 maintenance will be carried out on new loader B, the northern section of wharf shiploader rail and the rail receival shed. During this time loading will be restricted to No.2 berth using old loader and no rail unloading will take place. Terminal wheat and barley receival capacity is only by road during this period.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One barley vessel due 20/7.
Port Adelaide - One wheat vessel due by 31/7.
Thevenard - One wheat vessel due by 10/8.
Port Lincoln - One vessel due by 17/7.
Wallaroo - One vessel due by 31/7.
Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Giles - One wheat vessel due by 10/8.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Five vessels due by 29/7.
Kwinana - One vessel loading lupins, 2 wheat vessels in port, 8 vessels wheat due by 28/7.
Albany - One canola vessel due 25/7.
Esperance - Three barley vessels due by 28/7.
